name: unseen_paraphrase_generalization_v1
description: A small held-out paraphrase set for checking whether behavior transfers beyond the curated benchmark wording. Each case reuses source_state, target_state, and ground_truth from a base curated case, but replaces the user prompt with unseen wording.
reporting_note: Run and report this split separately from the 455-case curated benchmark; do not merge its pass rate into the main benchmark score.
